title: tests/README.md says every script but stress.py runs unleased; 9 suite scripts take a lease or slot
claim: tests/README.md says run.sh leases stress.py alone and every other script runs unleased; gate_lock.needs_lease answers lease for harness_headers.py and slot for 8 more suite scripts.
mechanism: The gate lock grew a second machine-measuring script and a heavy-slot pool (gate-scoping.md states both); the README's gate-lock section kept the one-lease wording.

evidence.unit: suite scripts besides stress.py that needs_lease answers lease or slot (claim: 0)
evidence.contention_note: shared box, other finder seats running; a count is contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb needs_lease: MACHINE_MEASURING=('tests/stress.py',) and every recorded time 0 s

metric_definition: count of closure.test_scripts() entries other than tests/stress.py for which gate_lock.needs_lease(<scope naming it>) is not 'none'
phenomenon_property: The README's description of which scripts run under the gate lock matches gate_lock.needs_lease over the suite.

null_control.note: gate-scoping.md's statement (stress.py and harness_headers.py leased, four slots) checks true on the same instrument

proposed_fix_scope: Rewrite the sentence in tests/README.md's gate-lock section to the gate-scoping.md shape (two exclusive-lease scripts, a slot pool, the rest unleased) or point to it.
